title: Trickle reset triggers (version/rank/config change) implemented in C only; Rust/Python reset on multicast DIS only; Python DODAG has no Trickle integration (draft 6.3, R-RPL-018)
description:
Spec: draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00 6.3 — reset Trickle to Imin on DODAG version change, rank change, DIO configuration change, loop detected (and do NOT reset on join/metric updates). Appendix-rpl sweep R-RPL-018, divergent, confidence high.
Evidence: C implements the full set — dodag.c:540-551 routing_inconsistent() covers version/rank/parent/config changes -> lichen_trickle_reset, config-change restart dodag.c:595-607, multicast DIS rpl_dis.c:118. Rust: reset ONLY on multicast DIS receipt (lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:644-653; runtime.rs:190; lichen-rpl/src/trickle.rs:246-252 reset(); trickle.rs:126-127 documents that caller-driven resets were never wired). Python: reset only on multicast DIS (rpl/dis.py:108); python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py contains no Trickle timer at all — version adoption (_adopt_version, dodag.py:628-638) never resets DIO timing. The do-NOT-reset half is respected in all stacks (R-RPL-019).
Suggested placement: wire version/rank/config-change resets into Rust rpl_stack runtime and Python dodag (or give Python a Trickle integration), matching dodag.c; add reset-trigger tests mirroring lichen/tests/rpl_dis + trickle suites.
